title: P1: Multiline paste can submit a prompt before the TUI is ready
detail: A two-line paste before bracketed paste is enabled can commit the first line as a prompt and start a run. The startup buffer captures and replays unframed carriage returns as keypresses in packages/sigma/src/tui/chrome.tsx:827 and :875. Return and linefeed submit at :51-55 and :395-412. Preserve paste framing across startup so multiline paste stays in the composer and an explicit Enter still submits.
